title: 【指定取消】第２回口頭弁論
contents: 原告　別添の資料に基づき、代表と代理人がプレゼンテーションを行いました。　　　傍聴席はほぼ満席でした（傍聴ありがとうございました。）　　　（期日の様子は報道もしていただきました）裁判官　９月１４日までに原告は被告の準備書面に反論を原告　　承知した。裁判官　被告は次々回に反論を被告　　承知した。裁判官　次回を１０月１３日１４時に指定
contents_en: Based on the attached documents, the plaintiff's representative and attorney gave a presentation. The public gallery was almost full (Thank you for attending). (The events of that day were also reported in the media.) The judge stated that the plaintiff must respond to the defendant's written statement by September 14th. Plaintiff acknowledged. Judge: The defendant will respond in the following session. Defendant: Understood. The judge has scheduled the next hearing for October 13th at 2 PM.

title: 【指定取消】第３回弁論準備
contents: 裁判長　　原告適格についての反論だけでなく、本案の主張を被告　　　承知した。裁判長　　裁判長等の交代を予定しているが。原告　　　次回は意見陳述、代理人の陳述として３０分をいただきたい。裁判長　　次回を７月７日１４時に指定。
contents_en: Presiding Judge: Not only did you refute the plaintiff's standing, but you also argued the merits of the case. Defendant: Understood. The presiding judge and other officials are scheduled to be replaced. Plaintiff: Next time, I would like to request 30 minutes for the plaintiff to present their opinion and for their legal representative to present their statement. The presiding judge scheduled the next hearing for July 7th at 2 PM.

title: 【指定取消】第２回弁論準備
contents: 裁判官　原告は反論を原告　　承知した。裁判官　次回を３月２３日１３時２０に指定。
contents_en: Judge: The plaintiff has objected. Plaintiff: Understood. Judge: The next hearing is scheduled for March 23rd at 1:20pm.

title: 【指定取消】第１回口頭弁論
contents: 裁判官　訴状、答弁書を提出されますね双方　　はい。原告山田代表　意見陳述被告　　１２月１５日までに提出する。
contents_en: Judge: The complaint and answer will be submitted. Both: Yes. Plaintiff Yamada Representative Opinion Statement Defendant: Submit by December 15th.

title: 新しい訴訟に伴うこれまでの準備書面の表記について
title_en: Regarding the notation of previous briefs in connection with the new lawsuit
contents: 指定がされたことに伴い、過去の裁判は取り下げ、新訴訟（取消訴訟）を提起しました。主張書面の混同を避けるため、計画差し止め訴訟の主張については、【旧訴】と表記をするよう変更いたしました。
contents_en: Following the designation, the previous lawsuit was withdrawn and a new lawsuit (annulment lawsuit) was filed. In order to avoid confusion regarding the written arguments, the arguments in the lawsuit to stop the project are as follows: We have changed the wording to [Old lawsuit].

title: これまでの訴訟を取り下げ、新訴を提起します。
title_en: The current lawsuit will be dropped and a new lawsuit will be filed.
contents: これまで、ＢＳＬ４施設計画の差し止めを求めてきました。しかし、２０２５年１月、厚生労働省は長崎大学に対し、ＢＳＬ４施設としての指定を行いました。そこで、これまでの計画差し止め訴訟を取り下げ、指定取り消しを提起したいと考えております。７月１７日に提訴し、同日、記者会見を予定しています。
contents_en: Until now, we have sought an injunction against the BSL4 facility plan. However, in January 2025, the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare designated Nagasaki University as a BSL4 facility. Therefore, we would like to withdraw the current injunction lawsuit against the plan and file a request to revoke the designation. The lawsuit will be filed on July 17th, and a press conference is scheduled to be held on the same day.

title: 弁論準備期日
contents: 裁判官　被告は準備書面を出しますね。被告　　はい。裁判官　原告適格について、反論だけでなく、関連法規を踏まえて主張を原告　　了解した。なお、指定の時期を知りたいのですが被告　　現時点で答えることはない。裁判官　次回を３月２５日１５時３０分と指定
contents_en: Judge: The defendant will submit a brief. Defendant: Yes. Judge: Regarding the standing of the plaintiff, not only counterarguments but also arguments based on relevant laws and regulations should be made. Plaintiff: Understood. I would like to know when the designation will be made. Defendant: I have nothing to say at this time. Judge sets next hearing for March 25th at 3:30pm

title: 第6回弁論準備
contents: 裁判官　原告の求釈明への回答は被告　　６月に書類は長崎大学から国に出されており、審査をしているところである。裁判官　審査はしていることは認めるのですね。被告　　審査をしていることは認める。裁判官　当面は原告適格について、網羅的に法令も含めた主張を原告　　承知した。裁判官　被告としては、どのような進行を希望するか。被告　　即答はしかねる。裁判官　今後の進行については被告でも検討をされたい。裁判官　次回を１０月１０日１１時に指定。
contents_en: Judge: The plaintiff's response to the request for clarification was Defendant: The documents were submitted to the government by Nagasaki University in June and are currently being reviewed. Judge: So you acknowledge that an investigation is being conducted. Defendant: I admit that an investigation is taking place. Judge: For the time being, we will make a comprehensive argument, including legal provisions, regarding the plaintiff's standing. Plaintiff: Agreed. Judge: As the defendant, how would you like the case to proceed? Defendant: I can't answer that right away. Judge: I would like the defendant to also consider how to proceed from here on out. Judge: The next hearing is scheduled for October 10th at 11:00.

title: 長崎大学が厚生労働省へ書類を提出との報道について
title_en: Regarding reports that Nagasaki University has submitted documents to the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare
contents: https://www.ktn.co.jp/news/detail.php?id=20240725011https://www.tokyo-np.co.jp/article/341401https://mainichi.jp/univ/articles/20240724/ddl/k42/040/270000c６月に長崎大学が厚労省に対し、書類を提出していたとの報道がされました。ＢＳＬ４施設の指定については、「申請」行為をしないこともあり、報道を頼りに実態を把握するしかないという実情があります。次回、８月５日の期日において、国側に上記報道について求釈明を申し立てます。その結果は、裁判期日後に門前集会にて報告いたします。
contents_en: https://www.ktn.co.jp/news/detail.php?id=20240725011 https://www.tokyo-np.co.jp/article/341401 https://mainichi.jp/univ/articles/20240724/ddl/k42/040/270000c In June, it was reported that Nagasaki University had submitted documents to the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare. When it comes to designating a BSL4 facility, there is sometimes no "application" required, so the only way to understand the situation is to rely on media reports. At the next hearing on August 5th, we will request an explanation from the government regarding the above reports. The results will be reported at a meeting in front of the court after the trial date.

title: 第１回弁論の経過
contents: 2023年（令和5年）7月11日に第１回裁判が開かれました。事前集会でも、原告や支援者の皆さんが、熱気あるスピーチをしてくださいました。国側は「準備にあと２か月欲しい。」と述べたため、次回は10月3日11時になりました。次回は弁論準備のため、傍聴していただくことができません。当日の集会や裁判の様子はマスコミでも報道いただきました。https://www.nagasaki-np.co.jp/kijis/?kijiid=1051675071948980449https://news.yahoo.co.jp/articles/a065e68c859e90c82cc979ad357d525ffc1cbd36
contents_en: The first trial was held on July 11, 2023 (Reiwa 5). At the preliminary meeting, the plaintiffs and their supporters gave enthusiastic speeches. The country side said, "I want two more months for preparation," so the next time will be 11:00 on October 3rd. I will not be able to attend the hearing next time as I am preparing for the hearing. The mass media reported on the meeting and the trial that day. https://www.nagasaki-np.co.jp/kijis/?kijiid=1051675071948980449 https://news.yahoo.co.jp/articles/a065e68c859e90c82cc979ad357d525ffc1cbd36
